direct.marking: x circle traversed counterclockwise; initial y uses principal sqrt(P(center+radius,t)) times (-1)^sheet
direct.scope: numerical period vector on the supplied closed lifted contour; root count and quadrature are numerical

initialization.marking: x circle traversed counterclockwise; initial y uses principal sqrt(P(center+radius,t)) times (-1)^sheet
initialization.scope: numerical period vector on the supplied closed lifted contour; root count and quadrature are numerical

path_exclusion.scope: Sturm exclusion on the supplied rational straight segments; does not bound numerical ODE error or distance to a pole

matrix.scope: continued marked period observable; numerical quadrature and ODE propagation, exact polynomial exclusion on parameter segments

operator.minimality: successive differential rows independent until first exact Q(t) dependency; minimal universal operator for this observable on the full period module, not every individual cycle
operator.singularity_scope: zeros outside the family discriminant may be apparent or poles of supplied observable coefficients; removability not asserted

operator.quotient_map: z=x-center; u=z^2; v=y; v^2=u^3+A u^2+B u+C
